notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'. No written deck guide exists for this Leader (an OP-18 Leader with no top-8 result yet): every claim is our reasoning from card text [CARD-18], so the guide is confidence low and the mulligan rule is labelled our reasoning, not sourced.

Every number here is an inference: the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression, cardValue and bias sizes were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan-g4.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.
goFirst false: strategy-concepts section 10 [S17]. The Leader makes every Stage in hand a +3000 Counter, so the deck defends well and wants the longer game (inference).

weights.hand 1.1 and counterAggression 1.1: a Stage in hand is a +3000 Counter, so hand cards are worth a little more and Life is spent less readily (inference). The AI's counter estimate reads the Leader's grant from its script (ai/src/knowledge.ts leaderCounterGrants).
cardValue: the Stages draw a card and add a rested DON!! when played; Franky OP18-034 rests a Character when a Stage of cost 5 or more is out.

mulligan: our reasoning (no SH- tag): an opening searcher, a Stage (a +3000 Counter that also plays for free with the Leader), and a card with a Counter; going second one piece short is fine, going first the searcher is required.

biases.cite: Its guide (our reasoning from the Leader's text): DON!! -1 plays a Stage of cost 5 or less from hand, so the Stage's draw and DON!! come without paying its cost.
Its guide (our reasoning): open with a searcher on turn 1 or 2.

assertions.text: Uses the Leader's DON!! -1 to play a Stage on its own turns T1 to T3 whenever a Stage is in hand and the ability is legal.
Plays a Stage before Franky OP18-034 when it holds both.
Plays a searcher (Iceburg, Nami or Tom) on T1 or T2 when one is in hand.
